metadata.title: Atmospheric Ethereal Portrait with Geometric Refraction

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, minimalist portrait featuring a subject partially obscured by geometric glass structures and dense white atmospheric smoke with a single bold red focal point.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a person with dreadlocks, wearing a white turtleneck, emerging from a dense field of white smoke. The head is encased in a transparent, faceted geometric structure that creates subtle optical distortions and reflections. A singular, textured red exclamation mark sits vertically in the lower center, providing the only saturated color in a predominantly white-on-white composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric glass facets distorting facial features
High-contrast red symbol against a monochromatic white field
Minimalist vertical alignment of all key elements
coreInvariants: Dense white smoke texture in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the upper half of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The textured red exclamation mark at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down through the smoke to the red symbol, then back up through the geometric facets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space at the top and sides creates an airy, expansive feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key value with zero saturation across 95% of the image, contrasted by 100% saturation in a single small area.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic white and grey with one primary red accent

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a small black rectangle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single functional sans-serif paired with a non-typographic graphic symbol.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, industrial look of standard advisory labels.
Provides a similar weight and authority for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a person with dreadlocks wearing a white turtleneck, centered against a pure white background. Add a transparent, faceted geometric glass structure around the head that creates light refraction. Layer thick, swirling white smoke in the foreground, partially obscuring the lower torso.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a textured, blood-red exclamation mark in the bottom center. Add a small black rectangular badge in the bottom-left corner containing white condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the smoke texture visible but not overwhelming the subject?
Does the glass headpiece show realistic refraction?
Is the red symbol the only saturated color?

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes through the glass

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red exclamation mark is perfectly centered vertically.
Check that the glass facets do not completely hide the subject's face.
Verify the white turtleneck blends seamlessly into the white smoke.
Confirm the metadata badge is legible but unobtrusive.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Geometric glass refraction + White smoke foreground + Single saturated red focal point.
